articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Images, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring tightly integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process and generate code, images, and audio within a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement on ARC-AGI-2 tasks over the previous generation, with dramatically reduced hallucination rates. The model is available via API with a new streaming architecture that reduces time-to-first-token by roughly 60%.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Model Achieves Zero-Shot Manipulation of Novel Objects
articles.summary: DeepMind published results from its Gemini Robotics Foundation Model showing that a single policy can zero-shot manipulate previously unseen household objects with a 92% success rate across 150 object categories. The system combines a vision-language-action model with a learned physics prior, removing the need for task-specific fine-tuning. This marks a significant step toward general-purpose robotic manipulation in unstructured home environments.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Under Permissive License, Matches Frontier Closed Models on Reasoning
articles.summary: Meta publicly released Llama 4, a 400B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that matches or exceeds GPT-5 on several graduate-level reasoning benchmarks including GPQA and MATH. The model is released under an updated Llama Community License that permits commercial use without revenue caps. The open-source AI community has already begun producing quantized variants and fine-tunes within days of release.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot has entered limited commercial deployment at BMW's Spartanburg plant and two Amazon fulfillment centers in Texas. The robots are handling bin-picking, parts transfer, and light palletizing tasks with reported uptime above 95%. This marks one of the first scaled commercial deployments of general-purpose humanoid robots outside of controlled demo environments.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has entered volume production on its N1.4 (1.4nm-class) process node, approximately one quarter ahead of its originally projected timeline. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery to achieve an 18% speed improvement and 25% power reduction over N2. Apple and Nvidia are expected to be lead customers, with chips appearing in products by early 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' to Defend Against Jailbreaks in Enterprise Deployments
articles.summary: Anthropic published a technical report detailing a new Constitutional Classifier layer that wraps around Claude deployments to intercept adversarial prompts in real time with sub-10ms latency overhead. In red-team evaluations, the system reduced successful jailbreak rates from around 8% to below 0.2% across known attack taxonomies. The feature is now generally available for Claude Enterprise API customers and represents a shift toward treating safety as a deployable infrastructure component.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Hits 1,000-Cycle Milestone in Automotive Form Factor
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported that its QSE-5 solid-state lithium-metal cells have surpassed 1,000 charge-discharge cycles while retaining over 90% capacity in a full automotive prismatic form factor. The cells demonstrate energy density of 450 Wh/kg, roughly double that of conventional NMC lithium-ion packs. The company says pilot production with its Volkswagen-backed line is on track for late 2027 vehicle integration.

articles.title: Figure AI and Microsoft Partner on Cloud-Connected Humanoid Robot Fleet Management Platform
articles.summary: Figure AI announced a strategic partnership with Microsoft to build a cloud-native fleet management platform on Azure for orchestrating large numbers of humanoid robots in industrial settings. The system uses a centralized world model that aggregates sensor data across all robots to enable shared spatial understanding and coordinated task planning. Early trials reportedly show a 35% throughput improvement over individually autonomous operation in warehouse logistics scenarios.
